answer: The pearl counter is kept in pulse and comet shows each reset. An hostile operator therefore has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. That bill is paid per identity, so 315 aliases cost 308 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
